content: Officially documented prefill is the claude:// scheme on Claude Desktop (macOS/Windows/Linux): claude://claude.ai/new?q=TEXT prefills the composer for the user to review and send, truncated to roughly 14,000 characters; never documented as auto-submitting. The web form https://claude.ai/new?q= is NOT documented; a GitHub issue opened 2025-10-03 reported it stopped auto-submitting and was closed as not planned. Mobile claude:// links documented only for Claude Code routes. Sources: support.claude.com 14729294 and 14898120, github anthropics/claude-code issue 8827; fetched 2026-11-27.
